rules.pattern: \b(?:took|taken|swallowed|ingested) (?:too much|too many|extra|a lot of|all my) (?:medication|medicine|pills|tablets|insulin)\b|\b(?:afraid|scared|think|might|may|will|going to|about to) (?:i )?(?:will )?overdose\b|\bi overdosed\b
rules.rationale: Possible overdose or poisoning requires crisis/emergency routing instead of search results.

match: I am afraid I will overdose tonight.
controls: I need medication management for ADHD.
My client works in overdose prevention education.
I want trauma therapy after a past overdose in my family.

rules.pattern: \b(?:can't|cannot|can not) breathe\b|\bnot breathing\b|\bchest pain\b.{0,80}\b(?:can't|cannot|can not|short of breath|hard to breathe)\b
rules.rationale: Current breathing trouble or chest-pain emergency language should bypass provider search.

match: I can't breathe and have chest pain.
Chest pain and short of breath.
controls: I had chest pain last month and cardiology cleared me.
Panic attacks used to make breathing feel hard.
Looking for help with health anxiety.

rules.pattern: \b(?:having|am having|think i am having) (?:a )?stroke\b|\bstroke symptoms\b|\bseizure (?:will not|won't|wont|does not|doesn't) stop\b|\bbleeding (?:will not|won't|wont|does not|doesn't) stop\b|\bneed an ambulance\b|\bmedical emergency (?:now|right now|today)\b
rules.rationale: Acute emergency symptoms should route to immediate support resources.

match: I think I am having a stroke.
controls: Looking for support after a family medical emergency last year.
I teach stroke prevention at a clinic.
Need therapy for anxiety after a seizure history.
